name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support to landholding farmer families, paid in three instalments a year into the bank account.

benefit.summary: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000

alsoCheck: Land must be recorded in the family's name in state land records
Professionals such as doctors, lawyers and CAs are excluded

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: Voluntary, contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers. The government matches the farmer's monthly contribution.

benefit.summary: ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60

alsoCheck: Not covered by NPS, ESIC or EPFO

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance against loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases, with a low premium paid by the farmer.

benefit.summary: Crop insurance at 2% premium (kharif), 1.5% (rabi), 5% (commercial/horticulture)

rules.label: Works as a farmer (owner or tenant)

alsoCheck: Crop must be notified for your area and season

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps for Farmers)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Subsidy for installing standalone solar pumps and solarising existing grid-connected agricultural pumps.

benefit.summary: Central and state subsidy on solar irrigation pumps

alsoCheck: Subsidy share and process differ by state

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Short-term credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses and allied activities at a subsidised interest rate.

benefit.summary: Crop loans at subsidised interest with prompt-repayment incentive

rules.label: Works as a farmer, tenant farmer or sharecropper

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Cash incentive for pregnant women and new mothers to support nutrition and rest during pregnancy and after childbirth.

benefit.summary: ₹5,000 for the first child; ₹6,000 for a second child if she is a girl

alsoCheck: Pregnancy must be registered at an Anganwadi or health facility

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Cash assistance to promote safe delivery in a hospital or health centre.

benefit.summary: Up to ₹1,400 (rural) or ₹1,000 (urban) in low-performing states; lower amounts in other states

rules.label: From a BPL household, or SC/ST

alsoCheck: Delivery must be in a government or accredited private facility

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Free hospital treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals for eligible poor and vulnerable families.

benefit.summary: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year

rules.label: Poor or deprived household (BPL used as a stand-in for the SECC list)

alsoCheck: Family must be in the SECC 2011 list or the state's beneficiary list

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (PM-JAY for 70+)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Health cover for every senior citizen aged 70 or above, regardless of income.

benefit.summary: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per year, regardless of income

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin
description: Financial assistance to build a pucca house for rural families who are homeless or live in kutcha houses.

benefit.summary: ₹1.2 lakh (plains) or ₹1.3 lakh (hilly states) to build a house

rules.label: Does not own a pucca house

alsoCheck: Selection is from the Awaas+ survey and gram sabha verification

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Assistance to urban poor families to build or buy their first pucca house.

benefit.summary: Up to ₹2.5 lakh assistance for EWS families

rules.label: Does not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Family income up to ₹3 lakh a year (EWS)

alsoCheck: LIG and MIG families (up to ₹9 lakh) may get an interest subsidy instead

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Free LPG connection for women from poor households, replacing firewood and other unclean cooking fuels.

benefit.summary: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove support

alsoCheck: No existing LPG connection in the household

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension for elderly people from poor households under the National Social Assistance Programme.

benefit.summary: ₹200/month (age 60–79), ₹500/month (80+) central share; many states add more

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension
description: Monthly pension for widows from poor households.

benefit.summary: ₹300/month central share; many states add more

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
description: Monthly pension for people with severe or multiple disabilities from poor households.

benefit.summary: ₹300/month central share; many states add more

alsoCheck: Disability of 80% or more

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students studying after Class 10, covering fees and an academic allowance.

benefit.summary: Compulsory fees plus a yearly academic allowance

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students studying after Class 10.

benefit.summary: Compulsory fees plus a yearly maintenance allowance

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year

name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship (OBC, EBC, DNT)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Post-matric scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students from low-income families.

benefit.summary: Fees and a yearly academic allowance

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year

name: Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
description: Merit scholarship for students from low- and middle-income families pursuing regular college or university courses.

benefit.summary: ₹12,000/year for graduation, ₹20,000/year for post-graduation

rules.label: Family income up to ₹4.5 lakh a year

alsoCheck: Above the 80th percentile in your Class 12 board
Enrolled in a regular (not distance) course

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed monthly pension after 60 in return for small monthly contributions while working.

benefit.summary: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60

alsoCheck: Needs a savings bank account

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Low-cost life insurance, renewable every year, auto-debited from the bank account.

benefit.summary: ₹2 lakh life cover for ₹436 a year

alsoCheck: Needs a savings bank or post office account

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance covering death or disability, renewable every year.

benefit.summary: ₹2 lakh accident cover for ₹20 a year

alsoCheck: Needs a savings bank or post office account

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Zero-balance bank account with a RuPay debit card, accident insurance and overdraft facility. The first step for receiving most benefits by direct transfer.

benefit.summary: Zero-balance account, RuPay card and accident cover

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA
description: Guaranteed wage employment for rural households whose adult members are willing to do unskilled manual work.

benefit.summary: Up to 100 days of paid work per household per year at the state wage rate

name: PM SVANidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Collateral-free working-capital loans for street vendors, with interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.

benefit.summary: Collateral-free working-capital loans in increasing tranches

alsoCheck: Certificate of vending or recommendation from the urban local body
documents: Vending certificate or letter of recommendation

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Collateral-free loans to start or grow a small non-farm business.

benefit.summary: Business loans from Shishu (up to ₹50,000) through Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus

rules.label: Runs or wants to start a small business

alsoCheck: Needs a business plan for the bank
documents: Business plan or proof of business

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs to set up a new enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities.

benefit.summary: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for a new enterprise

rules.label: Runs or wants to start a business
SC/ST entrepreneur, or a woman entrepreneur

alsoCheck: The enterprise must be new (greenfield)
No default with any bank

name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan
description: Voluntary, contributory pension for unorganised workers. The government matches the worker's monthly contribution.

benefit.summary: ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60

alsoCheck: Not a member of EPFO, ESIC or NPS

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople: skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive and collateral-free credit.

benefit.summary: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, ₹500/day training stipend, loans up to ₹3 lakh

rules.label: No family member in government service

alsoCheck: Must work in one of the 18 listed trades
One member per family

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Subsidy for installing rooftop solar on homes, cutting electricity bills.

benefit.summary: Subsidy up to ₹78,000 for rooftop solar; up to 300 units free per month

rules.label: Owns a house with a suitable roof

alsoCheck: Needs a valid electricity connection in your name
No earlier solar subsidy on the same house
